apps.name: Soirée Crew
apps.subtitle: Ta soirée, ton crew, ton taux.
apps.localizedDescription: Note tes verres et vois ton taux estimé, sa courbe et l'heure du retour à zéro. Sors avec ton crew : soirées, bars, jeux, chat, cagnottes et récap du lendemain. Estimation, pas un éthylotest : ne prends jamais le volant sur cette base.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to check in at a bar with your crew, and to share it during a party if you turn that on. It is checked, then deleted.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Your photos fill the party album, seen by your crew only. Their location is removed.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera takes photos for the party album and your chats, and scans a friend's safety code. Photos are seen only by the people you share them with.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice notes in your chats use the microphone, only while you record one. They are encrypted on your phone before they are sent.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: The calendar gets the parties you add to it, nothing else is read.
